domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
a is an integer and 0 <= a <= n - 1
E_n is defined at the rational number a divided by n
H_n is defined as an object that can be compared to E_n(a/n) (and subtracted by 1)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and for all integers a with 0 <= a <= n - 1: E_n(a divided by n) is at most H_n minus 1, and E_n(a divided by n) equals H_n minus 1 if and only if a equals n - 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all integers a with 0 <= a <= n - 1

variables.name: a
variables.role: input index controlling the rational argument a divided by n

witness_dependencies: the equality condition depends only on whether a equals n - 1

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every integer a with 0 <= a <= n-1, one has E_n(a/n) <= H_n - 1, and equality holds if and only if a = n-1.
